correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the new step to the projective stabilizer of one explicit side. Exact arithmetic proves the degree-seven extension is irreducible, reconstructs a valid heptagon with all \(14\) residual points on the Klein quartic, closes the full projective automorphism group to order \(168\), verifies the order-seven side rotation, and finds the side stabilizer has order \(1\). Orbit-stabilizer and the coset argument then give exactly \(168\) distinct lines partitioned into \(24\) septuples.

value.rationale: The union of constituent sides is a natural geometric object attached to the source's distinguished finite fibre. Proving that it is a regular \(G\)-torsor rules out hidden side reuse, gives a canonical coset-block structure, and refines the source's heptagon-level symmetry by a line-level invariant rather than by an arbitrary parameter specialization.
